owners.label: Blueprint
owners.description:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by 10%.
Casting Intro Skill - Convergence restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3 restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

owners.label: Boundedness
owners.description:
Casting Resonance Skill - Expectation Error or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array grants Proof of Boundedness to all Resonators in the team:
- Proof of Boundedness lasts for 60s and can be gained once every 5 min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than 30% of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to 3 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 3 times.
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 1 times.
- When Proof of Boundedness is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.

owners.label: Recursion
owners.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

owners.label: Decoupling
owners.description: Mornye gains bonus damage when responding to Tune Strain - Interfered.

owners.label: The Silent Observer
owners.description:
Basic Attack – Wide Field Observation Mode becomes immune to interruption.
The duration of Interfered Marker is extended by 150%. Interfered Marker now grants DMG increase even when the target is not affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered or Tune Strain - Interfered. When Mornye applies Observation Marker on a target, she also inflicts Interfered Marker.

owners.label: Morning Star of Entropy
owners.description:
All nearby Resonators in the team gain Crit. DMG increase against targets with Interfered Marker: Every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen over 100% grants 0.2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 32%.
Syntony Field and High Syntony Field further increase the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team by 20%.

owners.label: Blueprint of Recursion
owners.description: Casting Resonance Skill - Distributed Array additionally restores 25 points of Concerto Energy and 100 Relative Momentum, triggered once every 25s.

owners.label: Latent Variables of the Cosmos
owners.description: The healing of High Syntony Field is increased by 30%.

owners.label: Time Dilation Effect
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Critical Protocol is increased by 40%.
The DMG Multiplier of Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet is increased by 160%.

owners.label: To the Far Shores of the Stars
owners.description: Resonance Liberation - Critical Protocol deals 400% more DMG. If Mornye has not engaged in combat for over 4s, she restores Resonance Energy equal to 10% of her Max Resonance Energy every 0.2s.

owners.label: Interfered Marker
owners.description: Mornye applies Interfered Marker and grants the associated team damage bonus.

owners.label: Outro Skill: Recursion
owners.description: Mornye grants a teamwide All DMG Amplification buff.

owners.label: S2: The Entropic Morning Star
owners.description: Mornye grants teamwide Crit. DMG based on her Energy Regen. Syntony Field and High Syntony Field further increase nearby Resonators' Off-Tune Buildup Rate by 20%.

owners.label: Syntony Field
owners.description: Syntony Field continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators and increases the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team by 50%.

owners.label: High Syntony Field
owners.description: Syntony Field and High Syntony Field increase nearby Resonators' Off-Tune Buildup Rate by 50%; High Syntony Field also grants teamwide DEF.
